entities.name: Erasmus Quellinus the Elder
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Erasmus Quellinus I or Erasmus Quellinus the Elder was a Flemish sculptor best known for classically inspired ornamentation work and copies after the antique. He was the founder of an important Antwerp dynasty of artists.
